subsequentIntervalForLocalizationOnly.definition: Original nativeLogin last checkpoint to original startup-bundled first checkpoint. This is not an acceptance window and is never substituted for either original budget.

attributionLimits: SQL counts are from unchanged original queryCalls ordinals and closed scope labels, including concurrent daemon/device/background activity. No query is deducted from the failed473 total.

Most additional device/after rows have unknown request context. Only the commands scope six rows have captured GET /v1/devices/[deviceId]/commands, null action, current contextIndex112; methods for unknown-context rows are not inferred from route names.

The reciprocal scope-count distribution across adjacent intervals is evidence of different placement relative to the measurement checkpoints. It does not identify the same SQL parameters, request or work across runs.

A normalizedStructureId describes the conservative normalized shape; equal IDs do not establish redundant reads or equal parameters. No SQL text, parameter, user content or raw internal UUID is exported here.
The desktop RPC +2/-2 phase changes net to zero in the full login window. They are group-count differences, not proof that two identical query identities moved between runs.
Global outside-window query rows were not exported. The subsequent-interval comparison uses only the original counter snapshots, not invented query/context rows.
